svg.title: Two October 2026 server-side chains: PHP2Shell and the GitLab org-mode bug
svg.desc: Top, PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619): request 1 sends a multipart body that passes the size check but exhausts memory; PHP aborts mid-operation and the worker keeps pointers into freed memory; request 2 to the same worker reuses that stale state, giving code execution before any application code runs under mod_php. Bottom, GitLab (CVE-2026-110264): an org-mode file declares its own task keyword with #+TODO:, org-ruby escapes it in one pattern but pastes it raw into another, the regex compiler treats attacker text as pattern syntax, too many repeats overflow a counter in Onigmo, and code runs on the GitLab server with no login, CVSS 10.0.
svg.text: Two October 2026 server-side chains: PHP2Shell and the GitLab org-mode bug

g.text: Both: untrusted input reaches a native component below a memory-safe or interpreted layer.
